objective: Execute final acceptance: re-run the evidence commands for contract acceptance A1-A6 on the closed system and write the acceptance results table that closes the Stage

concepts: no-waiver rule (a failing item stops the Stage)

frozen_contracts.spec: report_jobs table: id UUID pk; status enum('queued','running','retry_wait','done','failed'); attempts int 0..3; progress int 0..100; result_ref nullable text; error nullable text; created_at/updated_at timestamptz. SQLAlchemy model ReportJob in app/db/models.py; alembic migration creates the table.

POST /reports body {input: object} -> 202 {job_id: uuid} (422 on invalid body, error shape C6). GET /reports/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status, attempts, progress, result_ref, error, created_at} or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found', message}} for unknown/invalid uuid.

States queued, running, retry_wait, done, failed. Legal transitions: queued->running; running->retry_wait (attempt < 3, backoff 1s/4s/16s by attempt number); running->done; running->failed (attempt == 3); retry_wait->running; retry_wait->failed (attempt == 3). Crash recovery: any row with status running at startup transitions running->queued (recompute, idempotent per A-2); rows in retry_wait resume their schedule. attempts increments when leaving running toward retry_wait or failed; progress written by the worker between 0..100.

ReportWorkerPool (app/services/report_worker.py): start(session_factory), stop(), submit(job_id: str) -> None (no-op if already queued in pool); run_job(job_id) executes one job to terminal state honoring C3. Pool size fixed at 3. Callable synchronously from tests.

JobStore (app/services/job_store.py), methods on a session: create_job(input_payload: dict) -> ReportJob (status queued); get(job_id) -> ReportJob|None; transition(job_id, from_status, to_status, **fields) -> ReportJob, raises IllegalTransition on illegal C3 transition; recover_stale(now) -> list[ReportJob] (running rows, per C3 recovery).

Error shape for all new-endpoint errors: {error: {code: str, message: str}}. Codes: 'not_found' (GET unknown id), 'invalid_body' (422). Job-level failure stored as report_jobs.error = {code: 'generation_failed', message: <str(exc)>} text field.
